_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro: Nde re'upa Klondike Solitaire. Ne rembiapo ha'e embohasa opaite kuatia umi pila fundación-pe. Reglas del juego: - Pila Fundaciones (F1-F4): Ejapo peteĩ as rey reheguáva - Pila Tablero (T1-T7): Emboja'o sa'i sa'ivéva (poyvi pytã ári, hũ ro'ýpe) - Stock: Emboguete tarjeta hetave itaju rovái - Waste (W): Tarjeta yvatevéva ojepurúva ñembosarái hag̃ua Ohechauka "empue" - Emboguejy ta'anga oĩva stock guive waste peve - 'emohenda <fuente><destino> [count]'-Emboguete mbogua aty apytépe Ejemplo: emboguete W T1', embogueta T1 F2', embogate T3 T5 2'. Ikatu avei eipapa 'opavave', oñeha'ãva omýi pya'eterei opaichagua carta ojereva hendápe. - 'ñemboyke' - Emohu'ã joko ha emoinge ne mba'epuruvicha ko'ágägua nde réra rupive - Pile: W pileta (was), remboguata F4-F1-T1, tembiapokuña morotĩrã (t7 tablero) - Mba'apo ikatúke ikatu ejaporavo ñembohasa ambue póso ndive peguáicha remomombyaty A table de la mesa oĩhápe Techapyrã: Rehechauka pu'ỹre añoiténte reguerekuaa papapykuera opyta reipota oñemohẽramo pe távape; tesa'a tapykuére: Esquema ohasávo w-1 = 'Ñemoambuesãmbyhýva f-1, ombohape'erãgui guahẽta raitypa rire upe tenda opytávaramo' ('forfe') - Rei kuéra iñambue añónte': Embogueraha tape omboguerahami jeiko' techa ndikatuichýnte ohecháme.
